## Checklist
- [ ] Tests added or updated; `uv run pytest --cov` passes
- [ ] `uv run ruff check .`, `uv run ruff format --check .` and `uv run mypy` pass
- [ ] No new runtime dependency in the core; any new dependency's license is recorded in `THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md`
- [ ] No model weights, audio or data committed
- [ ] Docs and `CHANGELOG.md` updated; no unmeasured accuracy or speed claims
